basic_profile.bio: I'm a former member of the LDS Church, now exploring life beyond the faith. Originally from Salt Lake City, I moved to Denver for a fresh start. I work as a software engineer with a passion for technology and gaming, particularly Age of Empires 2. I enjoy exploring new hobbies, including car maintenance and DIY projects on my Chrysler. Married with one child, I often browse Reddit in the evenings after work and on weekends. I appreciate thoughtful discussions and avoid drama and negativity.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science from Brigham Young University, I have a strong foundation in software development. My interest in gaming led me to self-teach game design principles, and I actively follow tech trends and innovations. My expertise is further expanded by hands-on experience with car mechanics, driven by necessity and interest.
